content: In many areas of the company, there is growing flexibility around vacation‑day carryover. While the formal policy still references a five‑day cap, managers and teams often accommodate additional unused days on a case‑by‑case basis, allowing employees to retain a larger balance of vacation time when operational needs permit. This informal practice can enable staff to keep up to several extra days beyond the standard limit, and, where appropriate, arrange for cash‑out of unused time at the time of separation.
